gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Wallpoet is a loud display face with smooth bends and tall lowercase, and Noto Sans Oriya sits under it as a friendly sans. Its generous curve gaps are the best thing here.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-osage: Wallpoet comes in bold and commanding, its lines broken by slivers of paper between the letters. Noto Sans Osage, a plain sans with inflated bowls, is the part that makes this pairing work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya has lowercase that looks oversized beside its own capitals, with wide, easy turns in every s. Yet Wallpoet is the strongest voice here, a display face with a bold, commanding stamp.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmon: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong has a high-set x-height and round shapes that gap like a cracked bangle, which keeps it contemporary and unfussy. Wallpoet over it is the bold, commanding stroke.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene reads as a modern plain sans, with curves that stop short and ascenders cut compact. Yet Wallpoet is the one that commands, while the body font simply carries the text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads clean and modern, its open-ended curves given room and its capitals barely above the lowercase. But Wallpoet earns its place big and short, where its bold lines can command.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Lines broken by paper showing between the letters give Wallpoet its bold, commanding look. Noto Sans PhagsPa sits beside it as a friendly sans-serif, see-through in its openings and gentle in its capitals.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Wallpoet is bold, with high lowercase and gaps between its letters. Noto Sans Phoenician, a modern sans with wide-open s curves, suggests itself for body text at a modest size beneath large Wallpoet.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pah: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads approachable and professional, with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise. Wallpoet adds the bold, commanding display voice above it, so the page has a loud top and a quiet body.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads professional and contemporary, with lowercase counters like wide glass portholes. Wallpoet is the display face that commands, bold up top, while this sans is built for the plain business of text.
